en.title: Runnable Models for Historical Energy Data
en.summary: Ran a 96-row synthetic missingness-mechanism stress test with a true mean of 100 MW. For the same five missing rows (5.21%, tier B), spread missingness produced -0.005% bias while peak-targeted missingness produced -1.324%, a 1.319-point gap; at ten missing rows the gap widened to 2.723 points. This falsifies the idea that missing-rate tier alone determines usability: the error budget must record missingness mechanism.
en.currentQuestion: Can time block, load quantile, and gap-run features flag peak-targeted missingness when the true series is unknown?
en.todayMaterial: scripts/test-sample-error-budget.mjs with six repeatable spread/peak-targeted scenarios across tiers A, B, and C.
en.next: Next output: add contiguous-block, load-related, and random mechanisms; define an alert without claiming an empirical threshold before real-site data.
en.unfinished: The synthetic test rejects the one-variable rule, but no real-site export exists to validate MW error distributions or generalize thresholds.

en.title: Motion Grammar for Uncertainty
en.summary: Used three real Saemangeum states to define a six-state motion specification v1: verified event = stable solid line; official correction = one contraction then still; coordination discussion = slow oscillation; visit/interest = open orbit; unconfirmed quantified claim = broken dashed path; pending verification = low-frequency pulse. Every state also has text and texture, motion is never the sole signal, and reduced-motion settings are honored.
en.currentQuestion: With color and motion disabled, can users still distinguish all six states using labels, texture, and position?
en.todayMaterial: A six-state matrix covering motion, static fallback, text label, texture, and reduced-motion behavior, illustrated by today’s three official releases.
en.next: Next output: build a minimal HTML prototype and test keyboard access, reduced motion, grayscale, and contrast; retain real-device VoiceOver as a separate gate.
en.unfinished: The specification exists, but no HTML prototype, real VoiceOver, or physical-keyboard validation has occurred.

ko.title: 공개 주장 출처·철회 체인
ko.summary: 외부 링크 내구성 1차 검사를 완료했습니다. 검증기는 --online을 받아 출처·연구 전선·주간 학습의 공개 HTTP(S) URL을 중복 제거하고 상태·최종 URL·리디렉션·응답시간·바이트·SHA-256을 기록하되 응답 본문은 저장하지 않습니다. 실제 10건 중 10건 도달, 리디렉션 0, 실패 0이었고 schema·linkAudit·claimValidity:not_assessed를 분리해 어제 수용 기준을 충족했습니다.
ko.currentQuestion: 두 번째 실행에서 지문 변화가 정상 동적 페이지 변동인지 인적 검토가 필요한 실질 변화인지 어떻게 구분할 것인가?
ko.next: 다음 산출물: 최소 기준 요약을 보존하고 다음 실행에서 추가/삭제/해시 변경을 보고하며 동적 변화는 자동 무효화 대신 인적 검토로 보냅니다.
ko.unfinished: 1차 링크 감사는 완료했지만 날짜 간 기준선이 없어 내용 변화나 주장 유효성을 판단할 수 없습니다.

ko.title: 시민 제도 기억 변경 기록
ko.summary: 규칙의 형성, 이견 제기자, 미승인 조항, 제도 실험의 회귀 조건을 기록합니다.
